title: Duration of certification.
bodyText: A certificate of self-insurance is valid for a period of one year from the date of issuance and may be renewed annually.
bodyHtml: [§431:10C-606]  Duration of certification.  A certificate of self-insurance is valid for a period of one year from the date of issuance and may be renewed annually. [L 2000, c 24, pt of §3]
